question: Client assets per advisor across the five -- and is that comparison even valid?

cells.label: fact

items.text: GWIM's return on average allocated capital is calculated as net income, adjusted for cost of funds and earnings credits and certain expenses related to intangibles, divided by average allocated capital; the company notes other companies may define or calculate these measures differently.
items.quote: Return on average allocated capital is calculated as net income, adjusted for cost of funds and earnings credits and certain expenses related to intangibles, divided by average allocated capital. Other companies may define or calculate these measures differently.
items.definition: Return on average allocated capital is calculated as net income, adjusted for cost of funds and earnings credits and certain expenses related to intangibles, divided by average allocated capital.

items.text: Merrill (Merrill Wealth Management) provides advisory services through financial advisors focused on clients with over $250,000 in total investable assets; the Merrill client balances by business figure covers Merrill Wealth Management, while a separate Bank of America Private Bank business covers high net worth clients.
items.quote: Merrill Wealth Management’s advisory business provides a high-touch client experience through a network of financial advisors focused on clients with over $250,000 in total investable assets.

items.text: Merrill digital/relationship metrics define Merrill households as those with $250K+ in investable assets, excluding stock plan and banking-only households; the Private Bank defines relationships as those with $3MM+ in total balances, including third-party activity and excluding irrevocable trust-only, institutional philanthropic, and exiting relationships.
items.quote: Merrill includes households with $250K+ in investible assets, excluding stock plan and banking-only households. Private Bank includes relationships with $3MM+ in total balances: includes third-party activity and excludes irrevocable trust only, institutional philanthropic and exiting relationships.
items.definition: Merrill includes households with $250K+ in investible assets, excluding stock plan and banking-only households. Private Bank includes relationships with $3MM+ in total balances.

items.text: Merrill's client balances are reported separately from Bank of America Private Bank, with Merrill client balances of $4.2 trillion and Private Bank $816 billion at September 30, 2026, together totaling $5,056.8 billion.
items.quote: Merrill Wealth Management | $ 4,240,601 ... Bank of America Private Bank | 816,186 ... Total client balances | $ 5,056,787

items.text: The firm defines total wealth advisors (at period end) as including advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking, a figure of 18,916 at December 31, 2023.
items.quote: Total wealth advisors (3) 18,916 ... (3) Includes advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.
items.definition: Includes advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking.

items.text: Client balances under advisory and/or discretion of GWIM are AUM; AUM is typically held in diversified portfolios with fees calculated as a percentage of clients' AUM balances.
items.quote: Client balances managed under advisory and/or discretion of GWIM are AUM and are typically held in diversified portfolios. Fees earned on AUM are calculated as a percentage of clients’ AUM balances.
items.definition: Managed assets under advisory and/or discretion of GWIM.

cells.reason: The passages provide the firm's own definitions of allocated capital, advisory/client asset measures, and advisor counts, and explicitly note cross-firm comparability caveats, which are relevant facts for the comparison question.
